round14_key_findings: XS selector is the most effective mechanism: ann improved from ~24% (baseline) to 35-38%
XS-MOM (momentum, lookback=7d) has best Calmar ratio (2.10): ann=35.18%/DD=16.75%
Budget ladder is critical: 3000U gives ann=50.05% for XS-MOM (hits conservative ann gate)
Short lookback (7d for mom, 72h for rev) + daily rebalance + 3-5 active symbols = best
2025 remains negative across all configs (-10% to -11%)
max_capital is low (733U for XS-MOM) - strategy doesn't need full budget
HTF gate + XS selector combination is computationally infeasible (both use O(n) per-symbol memory)
Constrained trials confirm center configs are local optima
skip_recent=0 is better than skip_recent=1 for most configs

conservative.verdict: ann and positive segments met at 3000U, but DD (19.67%) exceeds 10% gate

balanced.verdict: ann met at 1000U but DD (55%) far exceeds 20% gate; fundamental risk-return tradeoff

aggressive.verdict: Close to ann gate at 1000U but DD far exceeds 30% gate
